Subject: SysCore security follow-up: incident response timelines & SOC 2 schedule

Hi Dana / Ben —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a shared next-step plan: 

- SOC 2: you mentioned SysCore is mid-way through a SOC 2 Type I and targeting Type II later this year. Can you confirm expected report quarter and whether you have an external auditor engaged?
- Regulations: you indicated GDPR applies and parts of your workload may be HIPAA-sensitive (B2B healthcare connectors). We can provide HIPAA support via BAA and configuration guidance.
- Incident response / breach notification: we discussed wanting an example notification timeline (who gets notified, SLA targets for customer notification) and a short BCP/DR summary (RTO/RPO targets).
- Vendor questionnaire: you asked for a security questionnaire to start collecting artifacts on our side — happy to share our template and a list of typical attachments.

Proposed next steps: 
1) I can kick off the vendor QA bundle (SOC summary, IR playbook excerpt, BAA template) and share a Drive folder by EOD Wednesday (2026-05-20).
2) Marissa (Security & Compliance) and Neha (Customer Trust) will review any SysCore-specific asks and let us know if we need an NDA or redactions.
3) If useful, schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to walk through the incident timeline and BAA details. Please share 2-3 time slots that work.

Can you confirm: preferred email for a DocuSign BAA, and whether you want the standard questionnaire spreadsheet or an abbreviated version?

Thanks — I’ll attach the initial set of docs in my next message.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.inference/

Thanks Rishi — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2 timing: we are scheduled for a Type II in Q4 2026 but don’t yet have a firm report date; we engaged Clearwater Audit in April.
- BAA: we need a BAA that can be signed by our procurement team — we typically run a short redline. DocuSign to procurement@syscore.ai is ideal.
- Incident notification: for audit purposes we require a customer notification window (initial acknowledgement) within 72 hours of confirmed exfiltration, and a fuller incident report within 14 days. We will want to see your proposed notification flow and sample timelines.
- Questionnaire: please send the full vendor questionnaire; we’ll triage the sections we need answered during procurement.

Available for a quick sync on Tue/Wed next week (any AM PT slot).
